physical: Gibbs free energy is enthalpy minus temperature times entropy; at fixed temperature and pressure a process is spontaneous when it lowers the free energy. G = H − T × S
reflected_sentence: The definition keeps its shape: an unnamed available store is an unnamed fullness minus an unnamed warmth times Culmination (provisional).
rule_reason: Definition with no costs; definitions keep their shape.
interpretation: The minus-times form survives as a reading about what remains after Culmination (provisional) takes its share, but three of four terms have no partner. The spontaneity clause adds an alignment-flavored condition the frozen words can only gesture at.
closing: Decided by the rule alone: definition, zero costs, keeps. The spontaneity remark tempts a resistance reading of entropy, but the fixed list settled entropy as non-resistance before this batch, and I held to it.
